errors.unknown-host: No host called {host} (not in ~/.ssh/config, Yuzora's hosts or herdr machines).
errors.profile-host: A host needs an address, without spaces.
errors.port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.auth-transport: The connection broke while logging in: {why}
errors.needs-input: {host} needs a password or a decision. Connect from the SSH sidebar once first.
errors.auth-failed: {user}@{host} refused every login method that was tried.
errors.timeout: The host didn't answer in time.
errors.known-hosts-write: Couldn't save the host key to Yuzora's known_hosts: {why}
errors.host-key-revoked: The host key of {host} ({fingerprint}) is marked as revoked. Not connecting.
errors.host-key-changed: The host key of {host} changed (now {fingerprint}). Someone may be intercepting the connection; it wasn't accepted.
errors.host-key-rejected: The host key of {host} wasn't trusted.
errors.host-key-strict: {host} isn't in known_hosts and StrictHostKeyChecking is yes ({fingerprint}).
errors.host-key-unknown: {host} isn't trusted yet ({fingerprint}). Connect from the SSH sidebar once to check its key.
errors.forward-refused: The host couldn't open a connection to {target}: {why}
errors.too-many-hops: Too many ProxyJump hops to reach {host}.
errors.connect-timeout: {target} didn't answer within the connect timeout.
errors.handshake-timeout: {target} took too long to start SSH.
errors.bad-path: A transfer needs a source and a destination folder.
errors.edit-folder: A folder can't be opened for editing.
errors.edit-too-big: Files over {mb} MB are transferred, not edited.
errors.edit-conflict: The file changed on the host since it was opened; saves are on hold.
errors.known-hosts-readonly: Only Yuzora's own known_hosts can be edited here; ~/.ssh stays yours (ssh-keygen -R).
